en: Fixed resuming a headless or Agent SDK session losing the recent messages a compaction had kept, when the compaction followed a reply cut at the output token limit (compactions from this version on)
zh: 修复了在上下文压缩发生在回复因输出 token 上限被截断之后时，恢复 headless 或 Agent SDK session 会丢失上下文压缩所保留的近期消息的问题（适用于本版本及之后的上下文压缩）
